description: Routes nationales et départementales is a dataset listed in DATA Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by IGN. Extraction des routes nationales et départementales de la couche "Tronçons de routes" de la BD TOPO® v3. L’Institut national de l’information géographique et forestière (IGN) a pour mission de constituer le Référentiel géographique à Grande Échelle (RGE®) de précision métrique, en intégrant des données de référence, issues de ses propres bases ou provenant d’autres producteurs. Coverage: Aix-Marseille-Provence Metropolis. The portal files it under Transports. Its keywords are voierie, routes, bd topo, infrastructures. The portal shows 736 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-05-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte 2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ampmetropole-fr-portal.
